features: Wireless NVR with built-in LCD monitor
Built-in Wi-Fi router; 3 antennas (2.4G external, 5.8G external, 2.4G/5.8G internal); 1 built-in wireless network card
Only compatible with Hiseeu wireless cameras; does not support ONVIF
Compatible with 2.5-inch internal hard drive; no HDD included
Recording modes: alarm, timed, human detection
Playback: smart, regular, event; backup via USB and from app playback
Audio decoding G.711A/AAC; 3.5 mm headphone jack
notes: Spec table lists an 11.6-inch 1366x768 LCD; product title says 10-inch LCD.
Spec table gives the input as 10 channels at 5MP and key features state a 5MP maximum, while the recording resolution list includes 8MP. Maximum camera resolution left out.
Description gives a maximum HDD capacity of 6TB; spec table gives 8TB. Maximum capacity left out.
Power consumption stated as 5 W or less without hard disk.
